text:
[ITST.2.1] **Suites have different jobs.**

- **`impl/`** — author-of-feature also writes the test.
  Reaches into internal struct fields and functions
  (`engine.h`, `wm.h`, `dispatcher.h`). Catches
  refactor regressions and internal invariant breaks.
  Couples to implementation; survives only this
  particular libds.
- **`spec/`** — black-box conformance. Includes only
  `runtime/include/libds.h`. Each scenario cites the
  spec ID it covers (`IDSP.5.4`, `IDAT.4.1`, etc.).
  Doesn't depend on internals; a re-implementation
  of libds against the same specs must pass these.
  Spec-suite-specific rules are in [ISTS.1].
